fato_historico: 2020: Derecho in Iowa becomes the most costly thunderstorm disaster in U.S. history.
energia_do_dia: Today the universe encourages you to embrace the shifting winds of change. Much like a sudden storm clearing the humid air, your mind may find clarity after a period of turbulence. It is a good time to release what no longer serves your path and consider how you can transform challenges into new opportunities for personal growth and vibrant connection.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds can help you fly toward your most beautiful dreams.
significado_numero: Represents change and the courageous pursuit of personal freedom and discovery.
conselho: Keep your spirit light and adapt gracefully to the changing tides around you today.
